name: hugo-blox-academic-cv-starter
description: Academic CV starter template for Hugo Blox with Tailwind CSS v4

scripts.build: set "GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1" && set "GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.sslBackend" && set "GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=openssl" && set "PATH=%CD%\.tools\go\go\bin;%PATH%" && .\.tools\hugo\hugo.exe --minify && pnpm run pagefind
